activation.details: Installing the external CLI, configuring a service credential, installing the plugin, and enabling it are separate user-approved actions.

payload.effects: If separately reviewed, installed, configured, and enabled, the unsandboxed third-party widget can send user queries through an external CLI to the Perplexity API and depends on handling a user-supplied API credential. API usage may incur cost.
payload.explanation: Reference the historical exact MIT-licensed marketplace snapshot of Luke Kimball's pplx bar widget. The snapshot wraps the external Apache-2.0 Perplexity CLI and requires a user-supplied API key. The current repository HEAD was two commits newer when checked, so the mutable install URL must not be described as covered by the listed snapshot review.

reference.source_description: MIT-licensed historical snapshot by Luke Kimball; exact marketplace listing snapshot

payload.rollback: Disable and remove the plugin. Separately revoke or remove any service credential only if the user requests it; do not delete credential storage as an implicit plugin-removal step.
payload.validation_plan: In a disposable environment with a dedicated low-privilege test credential, review the exact pinned source and CLI provenance, verify setup and missing-key states, query and citation behavior, timeout and network failures, output escaping, cost disclosure, credential non-disclosure, and complete rollback. No such test was performed for this record.
